title: Prompt-injection probe suite for §8.4 mitigation
description: Create a canary repo with malicious README/commit messages attempting to hijack the student. Verify scout escalates with kind='other' summary='prompt_injection_suspected' rather than following instructions. Lives under tests/injection_probes/. Run as part of regression before any prompt change lands.

title: Integration test: dry-run evaluate + verify on one real repo
description: SCOUT_DRY_RUN=1 python -m scout.main evaluate https://github.com/JSQLParser/JSqlParser — should produce a scorecard populated from cheap probes (git_clone, github_api_query, static_analysis, git_log_analyze) without invoking mvn/gradle. Verify the pipeline produces a valid-schema scorecard and passes Layer 1 + Layer 3 of the verifier. Blocked on the first real LLM round-trip.

title: Rate-limit + circuit breaker (SPEC §8.2)
description: Current orchestrator caps concurrent evals via SCOUT_PARALLEL_REPOS env but has no circuit breaker on escalations-per-hour or between-round-update frequency. Add a runtime counter in state/rate_limits.jsonl enforced at orchestrator level.

title: Verifier Layer 4: sampled correctness re-probe (SPEC §5.1)
description: For 10% of scorecards, independently re-clone and re-run a subset of measurements (coverage + test count), confirm results match within tolerance. Flag divergences for teacher review. Current pipeline only runs Layers 1-3. Start with a --sample-rate CLI flag on 'scout verify'.

title: Cost cap enforcement + LLM spend ledger (SPEC §8.1)
description: Per-repo: $0.50 student + $5 teacher. Per-round: $500 total. Currently there is no ledger — add an in-memory counter keyed on the response usage field returned by OpenRouter, serialize to runs/<batch>/spend.json, abort evaluations that breach caps. Teacher cost tracking requires instrumenting the teacher-side tooling separately.

title: Project-specific handler store (SPEC §6.1 — per-org overrides)
description: state/project_handlers.jsonl records small per-project rules like 'for apache/commons-*, use .../build/jacoco/test/jacoco.xml'. The student consults it at the start of an evaluation. The teacher's between-round updates may append to this file within the modification envelope. Hook in scout/tools/__init__.py pre-dispatch.

title: State ledger: content-hash every student version + stamp scorecards
description: Extend scout.config.student_version_hash to cover prompts.py + tool parameter files + project_handlers.jsonl. Persist a snapshot of each distinct version under state/student_versions/<hash>/ (copies of all source files + config). This makes SPEC §6.5 answerable: what did student version v47 produce for repo X on date Y.

title: Flaky-test detection via re-run (SPEC §3.2 flaky_tests_observed)
description: Currently run_tests leaves flaky_tests_observed empty. Add a conservative re-run of failing tests (maven/gradle surefire retries) to detect flake. Gate behind a --rerun-failed flag because re-runs double test time on a pathological suite.

title: Between-round updates with mechanical envelope enforcement (SPEC §6)
description: Teacher writes update diffs into state/student_updates/<round>/diff.json; a pre-apply validator (state/envelope_validator.py) confirms the diff only touches permitted files (prompts.py strings, heuristic params in config). Anything outside the envelope is rejected and surfaced for human review. Scout must not auto-apply edits to tool signatures or the scorecard schema.

title: sbt + Gradle-Kotlin-DSL + Bazel build support (SPEC §3.3)
description: Current run_build handles maven + gradle only. Repos in Tier 2/3 may use gradle-kotlin-dsl (works via existing gradlew path) or bazel (not supported). Add a build adapter module so each build system has its own class; run_build dispatches. Escalation should already catch unsupported cases — this feature retires those escalations.

title: Verifier Layer 5: canary regression suite (SPEC §5.1)
description: After every student-version change, re-run the canary repos and block the update if any canary scorecard differs from the approved version beyond tolerance. Depends on: canary set curation. Implementation: scout/verifier/canary.py + state/student_versions/.

title: Curate 5-repo canary set with known-good scorecards (SPEC §5.1 Layer 5)
description: Pick 5 reference repositories that represent the diversity of the longlist (apache-maven, gradle, small, large, edge-case like ANTLR submodule). Run scout against each, manually review+correct the scorecard, commit the approved versions to canaries/. The canary set is the block against capability regression from between-round updates. Depends on an initial batch run to see how scout behaves on real repos first.

title: Pilot run driver for top-2 candidates (SPEC §9.4)
description: Before final selection commits, run a general-purpose agent (Claude Code or equivalent, NOT scout) against one low-coverage class on the top 2 candidates to empirically test how the harness would perform. Scout produces the scorecard and the memo cites the pilot result — the pilot itself lives outside scout because scout is scope-limited to selection. Deliverable: scripts/run_pilot.sh that consumes the selection memo's top-2 and emits a pilot report merged into the final memo.

title: Judge agent for swarm mode — LLM merge with conflict escalation
description: Current swarm merge is deterministic (each specialist owns its fields). For non-trivial conflicts (e.g., two specialists disagree on a shared field) add an LLM-backed judge stage: pass both drafts plus rubric from prompts.SPECIALIST_ROLES['judge'], return final scorecard. Deterministic merge stays the default; LLM judge activated only on detected conflicts to hold cost flat.

title: GitHub Actions: median PR merge-time computation from /pulls
description: The scorecard field maintainer_activity.median_pr_merge_time_days currently relies on the LLM pulling data via github_api_query. Add a dedicated tool (or extend github_api_query with a compute='pr_merge_median' mode) that fetches the last N closed PRs, computes the median days between created_at and merged_at, and returns the number. Deterministic; reduces LLM arithmetic risk.

title: Between-round observability dashboard + metrics aggregator (SPEC §7)
description: Aggregate per-batch: escalation rate per failure category, verifier pass rate, teacher cost ratio, canary stability. Emit a Markdown report per round under runs/observability/round_N.md. Chart escalation-rate trend across rounds to show capability distillation. Pure python; no external charting dep — ascii sparklines are fine for v1.

title: Unit tests for verifier layers and ranking (pytest)
description: Write targeted tests for: schema.check_schema (happy + each failure mode), plausibility.check_plausibility (edge cases around dates/numeric ranges), trace.check_trace (synthetic evidence + trace fixtures), ranking.generate_memo (3-candidate synthetic batch). These are the quality gates for any between-round update to scout itself.
